description: validate_header_form checks that well-known headers are not requested in incompatible forms: e.g. Date headers cannot be requested as asAddresses, address headers cannot be requested as asDate, etc. A future contributor might remove this validation as 'over-engineering', arguing that returning null is harmless. RFC 8621 §4.1.2 explicitly requires servers to return invalidArguments when a recognised header is requested in an incompatible form. Silently returning null would violate the spec and allow clients to silently receive wrong data.
title: validate_header_form rejects incompatible form/header combinations per RFC 8621 §4.1.2
